description:
Initiate an outbound, webhook-driven phone call where your backend handles the conversation logic.

Each call is individually authorized by the user: this returns a preview and places no call unless confirm=true, so confirm the destination with the user before dialing.
The agent must have a phone number attached and a webhook configured. The greeting is sent to the API exactly as you provide it. You are responsible for any AI self-identification required for your use case or jurisdiction. Returns the new call's ID, status, and the numbers it connects.

agent_id.description: The agent placing the call (ID from list_agents). The agent must have a phone number attached and a webhook configured.

call_screening_identity.description: Identity to present if the callee's carrier screens the call (e.g. your business name).

call_screening_purpose.description: Stated purpose to present to call screening (e.g. 'appointment reminder').

confirm.description: Must be true to actually place the call / send the message. When false (the default), the tool returns a preview and does nothing — every outbound call and message is individually authorized by the user. Get the user's explicit go-ahead, then call again with the same arguments plus confirm=true.

disable_recording.description: Set true to disable call recording for this call. If omitted, the account/agent default applies.

from_number_id.description: ID of the specific number to call from (from list_numbers), when the agent has more than one.

initial_greeting.description: What the agent says when the call connects, sent to the API as-is. If omitted, your webhook drives what the agent says. Ignored when wait_for_speaker is true.

model_tier.description: Override the model quality/speed tier for just this call. If omitted, the agent's tier is used.

to_number.description: The phone number to call, written in full international form with a country code, like +14155551234.

variables.description: Dynamic string variables made available to the call (e.g. {"customerName":"Sam"}).

voice.description: A voice ID (from list_voices) to override the agent's default voice for just this call.

wait_for_speaker.description: When true, the call connects silently and the agent waits for the person to speak first instead of opening with a greeting (no initial_greeting is sent). Default false.

name: make_call

outputSchema.description: The initiated outbound call, or a confirmation-required preview when confirm was not set.

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call, or null.

confirmationRequired.description: True when the call was only previewed (confirm was not true); re-call with confirm=true to place it.

endedAt.description: When the call ended (ISO 8601), or null if still active.

id.description: The call's ID (absent on a confirmation preview).

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number used for the call, or null.

status.description: Call status, e.g. ringing, in-progress, completed, failed.

items.description: One human/agent turn of the call transcript.

response.description: What the agent said in response, or null.

transcript.description: What the human said on this turn.

title: Make Call
